description: This file contains unit tests for the ResumeSource class, specifically testing its behavior with stream resumption, cancellation, completion, and failure scenarios using Akka Streams and TestKit.

classes.name: ResumeSourceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ResumeSource handling stream recovery, cancellation, completion, and error scenarios using Akka Streams.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and materializes the test sources and sinks before each test.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Shuts down ActorSystem after each test to clean up resources.

methods.name: testCancellation
methods.description: Tests whether the source correctly handles stream cancellation.

methods.name: testCompletion
methods.description: Tests whether the source correctly handles stream completion.

methods.name: testResumption
methods.description: Tests whether the source resumes properly after an error, with a new seed.

methods.name: testFailureAfterMaxRestarts
methods.description: Checks that the source fails after reaching maximum restart attempts.

methods.name: rematerializeSource
methods.description: Creates a new test source for resumption tests.

methods.name: createResumeSource
methods.description: Factory method to create a test resume source that asks for new sources upon failure.
